name: Southern Insight Meditation
reason: Too thin and no photo: a volunteer group in Christchurch with no premises of its own (it meets at the Opawa Zendo and hires Staveley Camp for retreats); both listed activities for 2026 are past and nothing is scheduled after 12 Nov 2026; the only site images are a Southern Alps landscape header and teacher headshots, nothing showing the group. Its retreat teachers include Jill Shepherd (on Spiritpedia), named as a visiting retreat teacher only.
